selection_policy: Remaining tier-A candidates (ranks 5 and 7 by A) not covered by the other two campaigns, for comprehensive tier-A coverage. Mechanism verified per enzyme from the UniProt/Rhea reaction: GLN2 is ADP-forming (Pg/O3B, 2 Mg); asnA is AMP-forming (Pa/O3A, 1 Mg). Not a template copy.
scaffold_policy: Union of residues simultaneously <=5 A from ATP heavy atoms and donor carboxylate oxygens in at least one of 50 WT poses. Counts retained; no cross-pose mixing of the two contacts.
interpretation: Exploratory monomeric first-step geometry. No activity or native-assembly claim. Report both deltas and sampling uncertainty; do not combine metrics.
ranking_policy: Rank by delta proximity-weighted angle versus matched WT only. Harmonic distance is a diagnostic, not a score or a cutoff.
folding_implementation: Stock Boltz-2 in explicit FP32, process-local guarded serial sample cap; 50 samples, 3 recycles, 200 diffusion steps; fresh MSAs.
